name: Government ethics
definition: Rules and norms about how people who hold public power may use it, and who checks them.
scope: Conflicts of interest, disclosure, clemency, appointments and the limits on each. Electoral rules and campaign finance have their own topics.

name: Public office and private gain
definition: Whether, and how, the law should stop officeholders and their families from using an office to make money.
scope: Holdings and trading rules, family appointments, published tax returns and the reversal of pardons. Bribery statutes and lobbying rules belong to neighbouring topics.

name: Business & Economy
definition: Beliefs about how people trade, work, invest and are paid, and what the law should do about it.

name: Business
definition: Business covers how companies are owned, governed and run, and whom they must answer to.
axis: favors tighter public rules on how companies are run and who they answer to, negative favors leaving companies free to run themselves and answer mainly to their owners.

name: Computers & Internet
definition: Beliefs about software, networks and the rules that govern them.

name: News & Media
definition: Beliefs about how news is made, paid for and trusted.

name: Entertainment
definition: Beliefs about film, music, humor and the industries behind them.

name: Music
definition: Recorded and live music, the people who make it, and the labels, streaming services and platforms that carry it to listeners.
axis: holds that music streaming has been good for musicians overall; negative holds that it has shortchanged them.

name: Humor
definition: Comedy in stand-up, film, television and online, and the arguments over what jokes are acceptable and who decides.
axis: favors wide freedom for comedians to joke about any subject with few social consequences; negative favors holding comedians to social limits on jokes that offend or demean.

name: Publishing
definition: The business of producing and selling books, from traditional publishing houses to self-publishing and ebooks.
axis: favors traditional publishers as the best path for books, readers and authors; negative favors self-publishing and open platforms.

name: Recreation & Sports
definition: Beliefs about sport, travel, cars and the outdoors.

name: Health
definition: Beliefs about disease, treatment, fitness and the systems that deliver care.

name: Diseases
definition: How societies prevent, detect, and respond to illness, from infectious outbreaks to chronic conditions like cancer and diabetes.
axis: favors aggressive public action to prevent and control disease (mandates, screening, surveillance); negative favors leaving disease prevention mainly to individual choice and treating illness as it appears.

name: Drugs
definition: Prescription medicines, over-the-counter products, and recreational substances, including how they are approved, priced, sold, and regulated.
axis: favors treating drugs as a market good with lighter rules on access and pricing; negative favors stronger government control over drug approval, sale, and price.

name: Government
definition: Beliefs about how public power is won, held, used and checked.

name: Regional
definition: Beliefs that belong to one place: a country, a region, a state or a city.

name: U.S. States
definition: Beliefs about policies and choices made at the level of an individual American state.
axis: favors a state government taking a bigger and more active role; negative favors a smaller state role, leaving matters to local governments, the market, or the federal system.

name: Society & Culture
definition: Beliefs about people, communities, the environment and belief itself.

name: Education
definition: Beliefs about schools, universities and how people learn.

name: Teaching
definition: Covers how teachers are trained, paid, evaluated and supported, and how much control they have over what happens in their classrooms.
axis: favors more outside structure and accountability for teachers, such as testing, set curricula and formal evaluation; negative favors more trust in teachers' own professional judgment.

name: Arts & Humanities
definition: Beliefs about art, history, literature and philosophy.

name: History
definition: History covers how the past is studied, written, taught and remembered in public, including monuments, textbooks and popular retellings.
axis: favors judging and reshaping how the past is presented by today's moral standards and priorities; negative favors presenting the past on its own terms with as little present-day judgment as possible.

name: Science
definition: Beliefs about what is known about the natural world and how.

name: Animals
definition: Animals covers what is known about how other animals think, feel and behave, and how much their inner lives resemble ours.
axis: holds that animals have minds and feelings close to our own; negative holds that the gap between humans and other animals is wide and often exaggerated by wishful thinking.

name: Social Science
definition: Beliefs about how people behave, alone and together.

name: Reference
definition: Definitions, statistics and quotations the other topics rest on.
